**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/10/01 (Sun) 14:45
- [USER] User asked about the philosophical view that the only person they trust is conscious is themselves.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The philosophical view that the only person you can truly trust is yourself is known as skepticism.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Skepticism is the idea that knowledge is uncertain and that we cannot trust our senses or our beliefs about the world.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] This view holds that we should be skeptical of everything, including our own beliefs and experiences.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The only thing we can truly trust is our own consciousness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] This approach to knowledge is often associated with the work of the ancient Greek philosopher Pyrrho.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pyrrho argued that the only way to achieve peace of mind is to suspend judgment about the nature of reality.
